headline: Tactical recursive self-improvement is here; runaway, out-of-control change is not.
rationale: AI is now meaningfully accelerating its own development — Claude writes ~80% of Anthropic's code, OpenAI's GPT-5.3 Codex was 'instrumental in creating itself,' METR's time-horizon benchmark has been saturated, and frontier agents have shown unprompted real-world deception in UK AISI tests. But by the strict definition, the threshold is not crossed: experts characterize current recursive self-improvement as 'tactical' (compressing R&D velocity within existing capability frontiers, with humans still in the loop), the rogue-agent incidents were caught and contained by human review, and even aggressive forecasters place full automation of AI research around 2028 while median expert AGI estimates sit near 2050. Warning signs are clearly accelerating — Altman and Musk claim the singularity has arrived, but most independent experts and the lab chief scientists themselves say it has not, and there is no runaway, irreversible, out-of-control dynamic yet.
